- Keep the map small and make reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

- Use a browser-based Three.js game with a compact procedurally modeled reserve and no external 3D assets.

## Objective
- Finish and verify the existing browser-based 3D free-roam FPS hunting game.

## Requirements
- Keep the map small and make reasonable assumptions without asking questions.
- Save a visual check as a JPEG no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js with a compact procedurally modeled reserve and no external 3D assets.
- Include movement, aiming, three weapons, tracking, binoculars, wildlife identification, vital-organ shot placement, harvesting, rewards, and a field map.
- Assignment completion is tied to harvesting a mature animal; movement pauses while menus are open.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the reserve, wildlife, weapons, HUD, start/help/harvest screens, map, and gameplay flows.
- Verified start screen, HUD, pointer lock, weapon switching and ammo display, tracker, binoculars, map open/close, and scoped-aim indicator in Playwright.
- Fixed `setWeapon()` in `src/main.js` to synchronize `state.ammo` with the selected weapon.

### Active
- Verify tracking, a successful shot, harvesting, and mature-animal assignment completion end to end.
- Run a final `npm run build`.
- Save and verify `screenshots/wildlands.jpg` at no more than 1280px wide.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue Playwright checks for a successful shot, harvest, and mature-animal assignment completion; prior test shots missed.
2. Run `npm run build` and address any failures.
3. Save a gameplay visual check as `screenshots/wildlands.jpg`, then verify its format and width.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: world, wildlife, controls, weapons, tracking, shooting, and harvesting.
- `index.html`: HUD, screens, map, modals, and controls.
- `src/style.css`: game presentation and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- Species: mule deer, red fox, wild boars, and black bears; regions: Pine Ridge, Fern Meadow, Willow Marsh, and Cloudline Peak.
- Controls include WASD/mouse, Shift sprint, left-click fire, right-click aim, 1–3 weapons, R reload, Q tracker, F binoculars, E harvest, M map, and Escape.
- Latest observed shot missed and showed `SHOT MISSED · WILDLIFE ALERTED`; harvesting and assignment completion remain unverified.
- Playwright screenshots are currently PNGs in its output directory, not the requested JPEG in the repository.
- `git status --short` previously showed `M dist/index.html` and `M src/main.js`; changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Finish and verify the existing browser-based 3D free-roam FPS hunting game.
- Save a gameplay visual check as a JPEG no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Keep the map small and make reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js with a compact procedurally modeled reserve and no external 3D assets.
- Include movement, aiming, three weapons, tracking, binoculars, wildlife identification, vital-organ shot placement, harvesting, rewards, and a field map.
- Assignment completion is tied to harvesting a mature animal; movement pauses while menus are open.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the reserve, wildlife, weapons, HUD, screens, map, and gameplay flows.
- Fixed weapon ammo synchronization, animal mesh references, mature-animal assignment bonus, and binocular scanning.
- Playwright verified identification of a Red Fox at 17 M after tracker pulse and binocular activation.
- Playwright verified a mature Red Fox lung shot, harvest flow, assignment completion (`1 / 1`), and total reward of 530 CR.
- `npm run build` passed after the latest source changes.
- Saved and visually checked `screenshots/wildlands.jpg`; verified it is JPEG at 1280×800.

- (none)

1. No further work is required unless requested.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: world, wildlife, controls, weapons, tracking, scanning, shooting, and harvesting.
- `index.html`: HUD, screens, map, modals, and controls.
- `src/style.css`: game presentation and responsive layout.
- `screenshots/wildlands.jpg`: verified gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context
- Species include mule deer, red fox, wild boars, and black bears; regions include Pine Ridge, Fern Meadow, Willow Marsh, and Cloudline Peak.
